dialogue_texts: I don't know what the heck happened and how my mind got taken over again...
I had to unravel that unsightly cluster of magic binding you gently, but it seems you've returned to us.
I want to hurry and escape this place, but...
There is no need to run.
If you expect to find peace, you'll first have to tell me exactly who...
Or what has coordinates on this mansion.
With your intervention, you should help most of Gensokyo's population return to their uncursed forms.
If pruning the root of this incident returns my lovely borders to normal, I suppose I will step in.
I really want to help you, but I somehow can't!
If the burden is too heavy for a fragile bird like you, leave it to the master of these lands.
Simply open your eyes and show me where the curtain rises on the mastermind.
It is quite rude to glare at a lady who has merely come to sweep up the stray garbage cluttering her backyard.
If you thought I could give up my princess to you, you're dumber than me!
All the time I spent powering up my greatest invention will pay off in a big way!
I will continue to take over Gensokyo's people for myself! They will be forced to trust the Order!
Oh, looks like I definitely have to leave now!
Go ahead and call upon as many layers as you wish - my gaps have plenty of room for all of you.
If they truly believe their little parlor tricks can shift the balance of my world...
They are due for a rude awakening.
If you thought Berenice Grieg was enough, turns out she has another subordinate and is responsible for this incident!
A director hiding behind the curtains? A classic play, yet so dreadfully unoriginal.
Do tell me where this leader resides; I must hand them their eviction notice.
That's right. Berenice has... a twin sister!
A mirrored pair makes for an interesting boundary, though it means I have twice the weeds to pull from my garden.
When Berenice broke into this place, I attempted to fight her off with my own danmaku.
But then she cursed me with this glohm stuff!
It caused me to act antagonistically, and you managed to come in earlier and undo the curse.
Manipulating stray hexes and brushing away uninvited danmaku are merely hobbies of mine.
Do stay tucked away so you don't get lost in the gaps.
Not too long thereafter, the other one came in for revenge and cursed me again...
Along with many other individuals in Gensokyo!
Defeating Berenice gave Veronica even more power to avenge her!
So clipping one sister's wings only caused the other to seethe with vengeance?
How tiresome. Let her swell with all the borrowed power she likes; she cannot alter her destiny.
I can't risk being cursed a third time, and you are my only hope for ending this madness!
